author: Cinna Davis (with OpenAI Codex)
statement: For charge one and label grades h=6,7,8,9, exact rational polynomial-kernel and determinant certificates prove that the cubic affine-energy pairing has ranks 8,10,15,19 respectively for every nonnegative integer output energy, conditional on the predecessor affine-energy identity. No all-grade rank formula or SAT improvement is claimed. At E=h the columns indexed by partitions without a part 3 are independent in these four grades.
